chats.zh-CN: 对话列表，配合 v-model:chats 使用。只有整体替换数组才视为变化，就地 push 不会触发跟随滚动。
chats.en-US: The conversation list, used with v-model:chats. Only replacing the whole array counts as a change; pushing into the same array does not trigger scroll following.

align.zh-CN: 对话布局方式，可选 leftRight（左右分布）或 leftAlign（左对齐）。

mode.zh-CN: 对话模式，可选 bubble、noBubble 或 userBubble。
mode.en-US: Conversation mode: bubble, noBubble or userBubble.

roleConfig.zh-CN: 角色信息，键为消息的 role。avatar 只接受图片 URL，节点头像使用 roleAvatar 插槽；color 传给 Avatar。
roleConfig.en-US: Role information, keyed by the message role. avatar takes an image URL only; use the roleAvatar slot for a node avatar. color is passed to Avatar.

hints.zh-CN: 提示信息列表。点击某项后触发 hintClick，并将该项作为新的用户消息。
hints.en-US: The list of hints. Clicking one emits hintClick and the hint becomes a new user message.

sendHotKey.zh-CN: 发送快捷键，可选 enter 或 shift+enter。enter 时单独按 Enter 发送，Shift+Enter 换行；shift+enter 相反。
sendHotKey.en-US: Send hot key: enter or shift+enter. With enter, Enter sends and Shift+Enter inserts a line break; shift+enter is the reverse.

showStopGenerate.zh-CN: 是否在最后一条消息生成中时显示停止生成按钮。生成中发送按钮不可用，点击停止按钮触发 stopGenerator。
showStopGenerate.en-US: Whether to show the stop button while the last message is generating. Sending is unavailable meanwhile, and clicking the stop button emits stopGenerator.

showClearContext.zh-CN: 是否在输入框中显示清除上下文按钮。
showClearContext.en-US: Whether to show the clear context button in the input.

enableUpload.zh-CN: 是否启用上传。布尔值同时控制粘贴、点击和拖拽上传；传对象时分别设置 pasteUpload、clickUpload、dragUpload，未设置的项为 true。
enableUpload.en-US: Whether uploading is enabled. A boolean controls paste, click and drag upload together; an object sets pasteUpload, clickUpload and dragUpload separately, and unset items are true.

canSend.zh-CN: 发送按钮是否可用。通常由内部逻辑决定，设置后以此值为准。
canSend.en-US: Whether the send button is usable. The internal logic decides by default; a given value overrides it.

escapeHtml.zh-CN: 是否转义用户消息中的 HTML 标签，防止被 Markdown 解析器当作 HTML 处理导致内容丢失。
escapeHtml.en-US: Whether to escape HTML tags in the user's messages, so the Markdown parser does not treat them as HTML and drop the content.

uploadProps.zh-CN: 传给 Upload 的属性，fileList 与 defaultFileList 由 Chat 管理，Upload 的事件以 onXxx 形式传入。添加或移除附件时 Chat 自己处理 onChange。
uploadProps.en-US: Props passed to Upload. Chat owns fileList and defaultFileList, and Upload events are given as onXxx. Chat handles onChange itself when an attachment is added or removed.

uploadTipProps.zh-CN: 上传按钮提示 Tooltip 的属性，不含 content；提示文字使用 uploadTip 插槽。
uploadTipProps.en-US: Props of the upload button's Tooltip, without content; use the uploadTip slot for the text.

markdownRenderProps.zh-CN: 传给消息内容所用 MarkdownRender 的属性，默认 format 为 md。raw 与 components 不可设置，自定义渲染组件使用 customMarkDownComponents。
markdownRenderProps.en-US: Props passed to the MarkdownRender that renders message content; format defaults to md. raw and components cannot be set; use customMarkDownComponents for custom renderers.

customMarkDownComponents.zh-CN: 自定义 Markdown 渲染组件，键为元素名，传给消息内容的 MarkdownRender。
customMarkDownComponents.en-US: Custom Markdown renderers keyed by element name, passed to the MarkdownRender of message content.

inputBoxCls.en-US: Class name of the input box.

hintCls.en-US: Class name of the outermost element of the hint area.

hintStyle.en-US: Style of the outermost element of the hint area.

update:chats.zh-CN: 对话列表变化时触发，供 v-model:chats 回写；先于 chatsChange。
update:chats.en-US: Emitted when the conversation list changes, for v-model:chats to write back; fires before chatsChange.

chatsChange.en-US: Emitted when the conversation list changes.

messageSend.zh-CN: 发送消息时触发，参数为文本内容和附件。
messageSend.en-US: Emitted when a message is sent, with the text and the attachments.

messageCopy.en-US: Emitted when a message is copied.

messageGoodFeedback.en-US: Emitted on positive feedback for a message.

messageBadFeedback.en-US: Emitted on negative feedback for a message.

messageReset.zh-CN: 重置消息时触发；由 resetMessage 方法触发时参数为 null。
messageReset.en-US: Emitted when a message is reset; the argument is null when it comes from the resetMessage method.

messageDelete.en-US: Emitted when a message is deleted.

clear.en-US: Emitted when the context is cleared.

hintClick.en-US: Emitted when a hint is clicked.

inputChange.zh-CN: 输入内容或附件变化时触发，参数为 `{ inputValue, attachment }`。
inputChange.en-US: Emitted when the input text or the attachments change, with `{ inputValue, attachment }`.

stopGenerator.zh-CN: 点击停止生成按钮时触发。
stopGenerator.en-US: Emitted when the stop button is clicked.

title.zh-CN: 自定义消息标题，参数为 message、role 和默认标题 defaultTitle。提供但内容为空时不显示标题。
title.en-US: Custom message title, with message, role and the default title defaultTitle. Provided but empty, it hides the title.

avatar.zh-CN: 自定义消息头像，参数为 message、role 和默认头像 defaultAvatar。提供但内容为空时不显示头像。
avatar.en-US: Custom message avatar, with message, role and the default avatar defaultAvatar. Provided but empty, it hides the avatar.

roleAvatar.zh-CN: 没有图片 URL 的角色的头像内容，参数为 message 和 role。
roleAvatar.en-US: Avatar content for a role without an image URL, with message and role.

content.zh-CN: 自定义消息内容区域，参数为 message、role、默认内容 defaultContent 和类名 class。
content.en-US: Custom message content area, with message, role, the default content defaultContent and the class name class.

action.zh-CN: 自定义消息操作栏，参数为 message、默认按钮数组 defaultActions、按名称索引的 defaultActionsObj 和类名 class。
action.en-US: Custom message action bar, with message, the default buttons defaultActions, defaultActionsObj keyed by name and the class name class.

fullChatBox.zh-CN: 完全自定义整个消息框，参数为 message、role、各部分默认节点 defaultNodes 和类名 class。
fullChatBox.en-US: Replaces the whole message box, with message, role, the default node of each part defaultNodes and the class name class.

inputArea.zh-CN: 自定义输入区域，参数为 defaultNode、各部分节点（clearContextNode、uploadNode、inputNode、sendNode）以及需要自行调用的 onSend、onClear、onClick。
inputArea.en-US: Custom input area, with defaultNode, the part nodes (clearContextNode, uploadNode, inputNode, sendNode) and onSend, onClear and onClick for you to call.

hintBox.zh-CN: 自定义提示项，参数为 content、index 和点击处理函数 onHintClick。
hintBox.en-US: Custom hint item, with content, index and the click handler onHintClick.

divider.zh-CN: 自定义清除上下文后的分割线，参数为 message。
divider.en-US: Custom divider shown after the context is cleared, with message.

uploadTip.en-US: Text of the upload button's tooltip.

resetMessage.zh-CN: 将最后一条消息重置为空内容的 loading 状态并触发 messageReset，参数为 null。
resetMessage.en-US: Resets the last message to an empty loading one and emits messageReset with null.

clearContext.zh-CN: 在对话末尾追加分割线以清除上下文并触发 clear；末尾已是分割线时无效果。
clearContext.en-US: Clears the context by appending a divider and emits clear; does nothing when the list already ends with one.

scrollToBottom.zh-CN: 滚动到最底部，animation 为 true 时平滑滚动，否则直接跳转。
scrollToBottom.en-US: Scrolls to the bottom; smoothly when animation is true, otherwise jumps.

sendMessage.zh-CN: 发送消息，不传 attachment 时消息的 content 为字符串。
sendMessage.en-US: Sends a message; without attachment the message content is a string.
